content: NeetCode's signature format always sequences brute force before optimal: state naive solution, explain WHY it's inefficient (the specific bottleneck, e.g. nested loop causing O(n^2)), then build toward the optimized approach step-by-step showing the insight that removes the bottleneck, with visual diagrams and a code walkthrough. This progressive-reveal framing (not just listing approaches side by side) is called out by reviewers as the key differentiator versus terse official editorials.
